entry.title: New: Bill 109 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, APPENDIX A, PART I, OFFICE OF THE MAYOR" The purpose of this bill is to amend the Fiscal Year 2024 Budget, Appendix A, Part I, Office of the Mayor, by increasing the appropriation for the Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Program by $1,478,750; deleting projects for Maui Family Support Services, Inc. and County of Maui, Department of Fire and Public Safety; adding a project for County of Maui; and adding a new appropriation for "CDBG-Coronavirus Program" in the amount of $1,726,202 with line items for a project for County of Maui and Program Administration.
